items.promptSays: Front-on perspective from the main south approach.
items.modelSays: The site path approach is east; the design entrance is on the local south face; the principal view is 245 degrees (south-west).
items.resolution: Generated prompts use the south garden/entrance side and state that the site path approach is east. They do not call it the main approach. The site approach remains a design decision for the hamlet layout.
items.phase3Status: Still unresolved at site level: the design entrance is south and the recorded path approach is east. The selected prompt states both.

items.promptSays: The upper balcony is at the east end.
items.modelSays: Upper porch p2 is on the south face of m2; the upper east opening is a door.
items.resolution: Generated prompts place the upper balcony on the south face. The east upper door remains a door, not a balcony.
items.phase3Status: The selected Offset Stack remains two-storey. Upper porch p2 is on the south face and has no door on that face; the upper east door has no modeled balcony. Access, guarding and support remain unresolved, and the generated prompt reports both conflicts.

items.promptSays: One long module and one shorter perpendicular module.
items.modelSays: Both modules are 40-foot (12.192 m) containers; the glazed link c1 connects them.
items.resolution: Generated prompts say two 40-foot modules, one rotated 90 degrees, with a glazed link.
items.phase3Status: Resolved in the selected model and generated prompt: both modules are 40 ft.

items.promptSays: An upper balcony at the east end.
items.modelSays: There is an upper east door (m2-e1) but no balcony, porch or deck object attached to the upper module.
items.resolution: Generated prompts describe the upper east door and explicitly say the balcony is not modeled. Do not show a balcony until the model defines a deck/porch, guarding and support.
items.phase3Status: The selected Cross-Stacked Retreat remains two-storey. The upper east door has no modeled balcony, deck or guarding; the generated prompt reports the limitation.

items.promptSays: The interior ceiling follows the butterfly roof with a visible ridge/valley line.
items.modelSays: The roof_form is butterfly at 12 degrees. Interior ceiling geometry is not modeled.
items.resolution: Generated prompts may describe the exterior butterfly roof but must not invent an interior ceiling. The ceiling is an unresolved design decision.
items.phase3Status: The selected Cross-Stacked Retreat has a butterfly roof and no modeled interior ceiling; the limitation remains and the generated prompt refuses to invent a ridge or valley inside.

items.promptSays: A fully accessible step-free home with adaptable bathroom and kitchen.
items.modelSays: Two 20-foot modules with a 1.0 m entrance, 1.2 m circulation target, step-free design intent and a potentially-adaptable classification. Turning circles, fixtures and thresholds are not geometrically verified.
items.resolution: Generated prompts say step-free design intent and list the recorded features. They do not say fully accessible. A professional accessibility review is still required.
items.phase3Status: Phase 3 removes the fully-accessible label. The selected home is potentially adaptable and carries the unresolved bathroom turning circle. The v2 image description keeps step-free access as a design intent, not a verified assessment.

items.promptSays: Installed photovoltaic panels on the solar-ready roof.
items.modelSays: The roof_form is solar-ready and solar_array.enabled is true; the upper module roof type is solar.
items.resolution: Generated prompts may show installed PV. They must not claim energy production or a specific panel count beyond the model.

items.promptSays: An upper balcony at the east end.
items.modelSays: There is an upper east door (m2-e1) but no balcony, porch or deck object attached to the upper module.
items.resolution: Generated prompts describe the upper east door and explicitly say the balcony is not modeled.
items.phase3Status: The selected Solar Studio Stack remains two-storey. The upper east door has no modeled balcony; the generated prompt reports the limitation.

items.promptSays: A compact alternating-tread stair is shown.
items.modelSays: The access.stair.type is alternating-tread, with a recorded warning about usability and code acceptability.
items.resolution: Generated prompts describe the stair type and carry the warning. They do not present it as an acceptable permanent-residence solution.
items.phase3Status: The selected Solar Studio Stack remains two-storey and retains the alternating-tread stair. Usability and code acceptability remain unresolved; the generated prompt carries the warning.

items.promptSays: Room-specific interior perspectives with accurate camera positions.
items.modelSays: Rooms are longitudinal zones with start/end distances. Partitions, fixtures, door swings and camera geometry are not modeled.
items.resolution: The pipeline does not claim a spatially accurate interior perspective. It can generate a room-zone plan and a descriptive prompt labelled as a conceptual interpretation, or refuse the interior view when geometry is insufficient.
items.phase3Status: Phase 3 adds authored interiors for Woodland Cottage and Accessible Garden Home and provisional room bands for the other four. Interior perspective remains unavailable. The v2 image descriptions mark the two authored interiors blocked pending reconciliation of their room polygons and opening positions.
